evals.prompt: 给 Blazor 组件写 bUnit 测试：RenderComponent、WaitForAssertion、事件触发。
evals.expected_output: Applies verified bUnit 1.x authoring facts: render, wait, click, re-query patterns.

evals.prompt: bUnit 里 Assert.Single(FindAll(...)) 报 Collection contained 2 items，看代码没错。
evals.expected_output: Diagnoses the selector-count trap and prescribes asserting the exact expected count first.
assertions: Asserts exact count instead of Single

evals.prompt: bUnit 的 Click 后下一个 WaitForAssertion 报 UnknownEventHandlerIdException。
evals.expected_output: Explains fire-and-forget Click and the pending-render race; prescribes cut.Render() + re-query.
assertions: Flushes render and re-queries before clicking

evals.prompt: 测试 InputFile 组件上传文件的重复文件名校验逻辑。
evals.expected_output: Applies UploadFiles pattern with re-query of FindComponent and message assertion.
assertions: Asserts visible status message and unchanged store

evals.prompt: 编辑了 .NET 工程，需要跑构建测试格式门禁。
用 puppeteer 在真实浏览器里验证 WASM 渲染和交互。
evals.expected_output: Routes real-browser verification to the browser verification recipe, not bUnit.
assertions: Does not replace browser checks with bUnit

evals.prompt: 调试 JS interop 在浏览器里 attach 失败的坑。
assertions: Does not treat as bUnit authoring

evals.prompt: 库的公共 API 被移除，要迁移 40 个测试调用点。
evals.expected_output: Routes test migration across removed APIs to the refactoring lifecycle skill.
assertions: Does not apply bUnit authoring facts
